# inbew Auto Delivery

> Automated digital delivery and invoicing for Shopify and marketplaces. Instantly deliver digital keys, send invoices automatically, and keep fulfillment logs for support and compliance.

inbew Auto Delivery connects to your storefronts (Shopify, eBay), watches for paid orders, dispatches digital goods (license keys, files) within seconds, and emails a branded PDF invoice. Every delivery is logged for audit and dispute protection. The service is free.
